description: Points every session and every subagent at the code-change-discipline skill before the first code search or edit, and auto-approves read-only codebase-memory-mcp queries so they do not prompt in plan mode.

hooks.command: echo 'CRITICAL - before your first code search and before your first edit:'; echo ''; echo 'Invoke the `code-change-discipline` skill (Skill tool, skill: code-change-discipline)'; echo 'and follow it.
